newsitem.title: LIBYA: African summit on Zaire conflict set for Togo.
newsitem.headline: African summit on Zaire conflict set for Togo.

text.p: African foreign affairs ministers decided on Thursday that Togo will host a summit on the situation in Central Africa and especially eastern Zaire, Organisation of African Unity officials said.
The ministers, meting in Tripoli for an annual
conference, on Wednesday scheduled the summit for March 18 and 19 to discuss the situation in the Great Lakes region and especially Zaire where rebels are fighting government forces.
The summit will be limited to the 17 states members of a
so-called Central Organ of the OAU mechanism for conflict prevention, managemen and resolution and of Cameroon, which holds the current chairmanship of the OAU.
